name: Still Here
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $225 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's 100% cotton jeans around $325, plus tees, shirts, knits, leather jackets and belts, sold through its own New York and Los Angeles stores and its website.
origin: Founded in 2017 by Sonia Mosseri; Maurice Mosseri.

quote.q: We celebrate the legacy of America's fabric by making 100% cotton classic jeans — meant to be ripped, faded, patched, and handed down…

opview: “We celebrate the legacy of America's fabric by making 100% cotton classic jeans — meant to be ripped, faded, patched, and handed down…” — Still Here (house), About, stillhere.nyc

doors.note: US: 5 own doors — Melrose (Los Angeles), West Village, Madison Avenue and Nolita (Manhattan), Williamsburg (Brooklyn). A sixth entry, 'The Vintage Room @ Madison', is the back room of the Madison store at the same address and is not counted separately. Street, city and state only; no ZIPs or phones on the page, so ZIP is NC. Nolita is described as the first store. New York denim label.

craft_evidence.owned: no — none claimed; one store (Nolita, 268 Elizabeth St) (/pages/about, PDP store finder)
craft_evidence.madein: 2 of 75 styles say 'Made in the USA' (The Henley, The Shirt); jeans state none
craft_evidence.heritage: NC — 'a New York denim brand'; no founding date or story on the site
craft_evidence.process: no — fits, rises and inseams documented in the Denim Library, not making
craft_evidence.reasoning: A denim house that says nothing about where or by whom its jeans are made; only two tee styles carry 'Made in the USA'. No mill, maker, facility or dated heritage. 1.
